description: State Ministry of Production, Supply and Regulation of Pharmaceuticals - Amendment to Medicines (Ceiling on Prices) Regulations, 2019
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, No. 5 of 2015. It specifically amends previous regulations regarding price ceilings on medicines, which constitutes regulatory/legal framework matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
